beautifului.name: beautifului.dev
beautifului.notes: No published terms. Full source is stored LOCALLY for study (licence_ok=0 on every snapshot) because the operator wants the code available to agents; never redistributed, never copied into a shipping repo. Send a licence enquiry before any reuse beyond study.

beui.name: beUI
beui.notes: Publishes an agent surface by design: /r index, /r/{slug} detail with every file inline, /r/{slug}/raw, /llms.txt and a hosted MCP server at https://mcp.beui.dev/mcp.

rareui.name: Rare UI
rareui.licence: free to use, repo reports NOASSERTION
rareui.notes: shadcn registry (swamimalode07/rare-ui): /r/registry.json plus /r/{name}.json with file content inline. llms.txt says every component is free to use; the GitHub repo carries no named licence, so source is stored locally with licence_ok=0.

shadcn.name: shadcn/ui
shadcn.notes: Registry feed: /r/index.json lists components, /r/styles/new-york-v4/<name>.json returns full source + cssVars + deps.

transitions.name: Transitions.dev
transitions.licence: MIT, collection may not be republished
transitions.notes: Terms: use in as many projects as you like, including commercial; may not repackage, resell or publish the collection. Pro transitions are paywalled and carry no code. MEASURED: 21 of the 32 free transitions use the same curve cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); the rest are one-offs (0.4/0/0.2/1, three 0.34/1.2-1.96/0.64/1 springs, 0.16/1/0.3/1). Duration ladder by frequency: 250ms and 350ms (9 each), 150ms (8), 500ms and 400ms (5 each). That independently confirms 250ms as the middle step our --motion uses.
